usage: 炒西洋菜 is commonly used as a noun referring to a cooked vegetable dish.
You can use it as the object of verbs like 食 (eat), 叫 (order), 煮 (cook), or 炒 (stir-fry).
It is a natural dish name in restaurant and home cooking contexts.
In restaurant settings, it often appears with measure words such as 碟, for example: 一碟炒西洋菜.
It can also be compared with other vegetable dishes, such as 炒西洋菜比炒菠菜好食.
